// least-squares plane of a point set; its normal is the direction of least
// variance. (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Principal_component_analysis)
type PlaneFit3D
    implements IValue, IFitted
{
    Plane: Plane;
    Quality: FitQuality;
}
